cloudflare_tunnel_finding.conclusion: Ingress is edge-managed via the dashboard, not from any local file. There is no local config on this host that can route a public hostname to port 8765, so public exposure cannot be completed from the mini alone.

security_posture.rationale: Tailnet is an authenticated private mesh. Binding every interface would publish an unauthenticated page to the local network.

verification.method: curl against each interface after launchd re-bootstrap, plus lsof to confirm actual bound sockets
